holders_source: Eastmoney datacenter RPT_HOLDERNUM_DET per stock; fields HOLDER_NUM, PRE_HOLDER_NUM, TOTAL_A_SHARES, END_DATE, HOLD_NOTICE_DATE

hypotheses.mechanism: Falling shareholder count between consecutive reports = chips concentrating into fewer hands (informed accumulation, retail exit). Long the quintile with the largest QoQ decline. score = -(HOLDER_NUM / PRE_HOLDER_NUM - 1) from the latest announced report.
Persistent concentration over two reports. Long the quintile with the largest decline vs the report two periods back. score = -(HOLDER_NUM_t / HOLDER_NUM_{t-2} - 1).
Fewer holders per A-share outstanding = concentrated ownership level. Long the quintile with the lowest holders/share. score = -(HOLDER_NUM / TOTAL_A_SHARES).

pit_rule: value from report R visible from the first session strictly after HOLD_NOTICE_DATE(R); rows with HOLD_NOTICE_DATE > 2024-02-29 dropped at compile
universe: eligible names in the frozen panel with at least one announced holder-count report
